messages:
sarah: quick post-RFC: propose 'tile' slots (fixed 6ms windows) + small per-tenant burst pool and an entropy budget to bound reshuffles. want quick feedback and rollout plan.

matt: sounds interesting. difference from cohorts?

sarah: tiles are short fixed windows recycled across GPUs. reduces variable cohort lifetimes and makes eviction points predictable.

jin: watch kv-cache cold starts if requests shift tiles. need metrics for warmup.

ahmed: entropy budget?? how avoid long preempt waits?

sarah: budget = X ms of reshuffle work per reclaim; if exceeded use fallback (serve current packing or burst pool). keeps preempt bounded.

lina: add obs: tile_fill_pct, tile_evictions, preempt_reshuffle_ms, kvcache_cold_pct. alerts on p99 reshuffle > 10ms.

matt: rollout opt-in per-pool 5%->25%->100% with kill-switch. add synthetic 8k prefix tests.

deploy-bot: scheduled experiment "tile-scheduler-canary" (id=tile-2026-03-23-02)

sarah: I'll draft RFC update + runbook. action owners: matt canary route, jin perf tests, ahmed autoswitch, lina dashboards. thanks :thumbsup:
